posts.author: Not-Star
posts.body:
This might be a dumb question, but
How do you get rid of the white background?

posts.author: Amysaurus
posts.body:
It depends on the program you're using, but in general, you'd find a "Select By Color" or "Magic Wand" tool, change the tolerance or threshold level to 0, then select the white color. From there, use a cut or delete function to get rid of the background, and save the image. Otherwise, import the spritesheet into RPG Maker, then select the background color before clicking OK.
I hope that helps, and feel free to shoot me a PM if you're still having trouble.

Click to expand...
Sorry to hijack this question, but I'm sure I can help. I'm pretty sure that this is based off the RTP, so I'm you need VX Ace to use it in other Makers. That's actually a major rule in the RPG Maker franchise. If you want to use resources from another Maker, you'll need to own the specific Maker first, even if you don't use it.
I literally bought VX Ace just to use its resources, and I think they're fun to work with in MZ. Especially the music. VXAce BGM really slaps. Anyway, just snatch up the Maker (there's sales sometimes too, good to try and take advantage of those) and then you can use the RTP as well as edits like these.
